strings.l2_lesson4_step5_body: Minus 5 → obere Perle nach OBEN. Minus mehr als 5 → erst die unteren weg, dann die obere. Ganz ohne Formel! 🚀
strings.l2_lesson5_step2_body: Schau zu! Start bei 3, plus 5 → obere Perle nach UNTEN → obere + 3 untere = 8! 🎯
strings.l2_lesson10_step3_body: Probier 6+9. Obere + 1 untere = 6. Übertrag zu den Zehnern (+10), 1 untere weg (−1), die obere bleibt unten. 6+9=15! 🎯

notes.l2_lesson4_step5_body: Reading verified: lesson 4 pool is subtract 5-9 from 5-9 with result < 5, so "Subtract more" = minus 6 to 9; "Mehr als 5 minus" is unnatural word order, "Minus mehr als 5" is parallel to "Minus 5" and clear.
notes.l2_lesson5_step2_body: Bead move: from 3 (3 untere oben) to 8 you only push the heaven bead down, the 3 earth beads stay (animation 3 → ones(true,3)); "wechsle zur oberen" tells the child to swap the earth beads away, which gives 5, not 8.
notes.l2_lesson10_step3_body: Factual error carried over from the English: 6 = obere + 1 untere, so "obere nach OBEN (6→1) ... 4 untere dazu" is impossible (only 3 earth beads free) and the app animates 6 → 15 as tens +1 and ONE earth bead down with the heaven bead staying (l2FormulaRodMovements(6, 15, 2)); numbers kept, moves now match the animation.
notes.l2_phase_apply: "+4 wird gerechnet" is not idiomatic with a term as subject; "Jetzt kommt +4" is natural and fits the phase sequence Start bei 0 → 3 wird eingestellt → Jetzt: 3 → Jetzt kommt +4 → Ergebnis: 7.
notes.l3_secs: Seconds were written two ways in the chunk ("30 s" on the time chips, "Sek." in l3_unit_sec); chunk 02 report_seconds_value is "%1$d Sek." too, so the chips use the same unit.
